name: Burp Suite Community Edition
author: PortSwigger Ltd
summary: The best manual tools to start web security testing.
description: Burp Suite Community Edition is PortSwigger's essential manual toolkit for learning about web security testing.

versions.release_notes: This release includes improvements to Burp's installation process
This release introduces custom CA certificate support, host-level SOCKS proxy bypass, the ability to hide decoded hover tooltips, some bug fixes, and a browser upgrade.
This release upgrades Burp's browser to Chromium 146.0.7680.154 for Windows & Mac and 146.0.7680.153 for Linux
This release adds Organizer collections with secure sharing, a split request and response view in Intruder, Proxy search, plus performance improvements, bug fixes, and a browser upgrade.
Professional / Community 2026.1.5 released to the Stable channel. This release fixes a bug that was causing Burp Scanner to make unnecessary requests.
This release fixes an issue that prevented some extensions from loading correctly.
This release introduces the Discover tab, faster table navigation with command palette, smarter SQLi detection, SPNEGO support for NTLM, plus other improvements, a Java update, and a browser upgrade.
This release upgrades Burp's browser to Chromium 144.0.7559.97 for Windows & Mac and 144.0.7559.96 for Linux
